title: for benchmarking, let's create another option when creating a new benchmark to select the different models at each cate…
summary: I've written the plan for a new "by difficulty" benchmark arm. You pick one model each for easy, medium and hard work, and each can come from a different provider or subscription. For example: easy on DeepSeek via OpenRouter, medium on Sonnet through your Claude plan, hard on GPT-5.4 through your ChatGPT plan.
